credits.title: Udta Teer
credits.overview: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

credits.title: Kartaa
credits.overview: When your fate is sealed, what can you do to undo it?

credits.title: Dark Wind
credits.overview: In a village affected by climate change and scanty rainfall, a blind farmer strikes a deal with the debt recovery agent to save his son from a debt trap.

credits.title: Jalpari
credits.overview: Tomboy Shreya coaxes her widower father Dev to take her to their ancestral village in Haryana something he is not too keen about. Eventually she gets her way and along with her dad, her brother Sam and granny, she reaches her destination only to understand why her father had been putting off the trip for years.
